description: For existing destinations use campaign.id and adSet.id (never existingCampaignId or existingAdSetId); campaign.name and adSet.name request new destinations. For standard ad text use headlines arrays, e.g. texts.perAd["photo.jpg"] = { headlines: ["New headline"] }, or texts.common.headlines for shared copy. A singular headline string is accepted as a one-element alias; conflicting headline/headlines values are rejected. Create ads from a v1 AdSpec request body or saved build, including Instagram existing-post partnership ads with common, per-ad-set, or per-ad sponsors and text. Import by Instagram URL, shortcode, source ID, or ad code in mediaItems. Uploaded media supports Facebook and Instagram partnerships: set profile.partnership.enabled, shared or campaign sponsors, and texts.perAd/perAdset sponsors. Null both row sponsor IDs means No Partner; sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount supports Instagram-only partners. Approval is checked for the effective First Identity. Omit uploaderMode for uploads. Facebook post imports, mixed post/upload batches and Threads on imported posts are unsupported. Uploaded-media texts.perAd keys are file names or media:<uploadId>; a file name that two uploads share is refused, so rename one or use media:<uploadId>. CTA fields use Meta enum values such as SHOP_NOW. Standard ads normalize human labels such as Shop Now; imported partnership posts require the enum and do not normalize labels. Saved builds with mediaItems launch only those selected items and their linked placements; upload batches supply missing media details. Without mediaItems, uploadId selects the whole batch. Launch is refused when the planned ad count differs from a complete saved display. Missing library-video thumbnails are recovered from Meta at preview/create without re-uploading the video. Supports campaign-qualified texts.perAdset overrides and per-campaign profile.campaigns identities in multi-campaign launches. Local polling blocks until the server job completes or the 30 minute ceiling is reached. The hosted tool polls for about 40 seconds, then returns status "still_running" with jobId. If it returns status "still_running", the job is still progressing server-side; call ads_get_job with the returned jobId until complete is true. New campaigns/ad sets with lifetime budgets require an effective end at least 24 hours after the start; otherwise create returns HTTP 400 with a LIFETIME_BUDGET_END_* code. Set options.schedule.endTime or use a daily budget. Existing ad set end-date warnings remain non-blocking. Missing library-video thumbnails are recovered from Meta at preview/create; only the thumbnail image is uploaded, never the video. For videos, mediaItems[].mediaId MUST be the numeric Facebook video id from the upload response videoId, not its internal id. videoId is accepted as an alias. linkedAssets[] follow the same rule. Internal upload ids are resolved on save only for uploads owned by the authenticated user in the selected account; otherwise a video without a numeric id or batch link makes the build unlaunchable. Canonical 4x5 primary with linked 9x16 item: {"mediaName":"X__H01.mp4","mediaType":"video","mediaId":"1805649190475379","thumbnailHash":"PRIMARY_THUMBNAIL_HASH","placementType":"portrait","isGroupPrimary":true,"assetGroupId":"ag_1","linkedAssets":[{"mediaName":"X__H01-9x16.mp4","mediaType":"video","mediaId":"1234567890","thumbnailHash":"STORY_THUMBNAIL_HASH","placementType":"story"}]} Preset-only requests reuse the saved campaign and ad set, including saved builds. Preview and create add a non-fatal PRESET_DESTINATION_USED warning. Use campaign.name or named multi-campaign entries for new campaigns, or campaign.id / adSet.id to override the saved destination. With campaign.id alone, new ad sets are created. copyFromAd behavior is unchanged. If a call times out or drops without a reply, do not create a new launch: within 10 minutes, call ads_create again with the exact same arguments (an identical repeat returns the existing job instead of creating duplicates; pass the same idempotencyKey to extend this to 24 hours), otherwise poll the known jobId with ads_get_job or check ads_list_history. Set options.allowRepeatLaunch only when the user explicitly wants the same ads created again. If it returns status "approval_required", show the user the returned url to review and launch in Ads Uploader. Nothing launched; do not retry after receiving the url. A transport retry returns the same approval build. With Launch set to Approval, optional runTitle, reviewId and reason place the held launch in your Agent Inbox run: pass the reviewId from an earlier ads_edit_preview or ads_duplicate (or the same runTitle) so the user approves your changes and this launch together, changes first. The result then includes that reviewId. A reviewId from another user or ad account is refused. When Launch is Allowed they are ignored: create goes straight to Meta, is not added to the Agent Inbox review, and returns an IGNORED_FIELD warning listing the supplied fields. ads_preview reports launch.mode (allowed or approval). When allowed, show LAUNCH_GOES_LIVE prominently: create sends objects straight to Meta without review; ACTIVE objects can start spending immediately and PAUSED objects are created paused. Set status PAUSED or change Launch to Approval on Account Permissions to review first. When approval, create is held for approval. The account approval rule applies to edits, not new-ad launches. An edit reviewId does not gate create: reviewId, runTitle and reason only take effect when Launch is Approval.

adSet.description: Existing destination: set adSet.id. New destination: set adSet.name or a supported creation mode. Unsupported destination keys fail validation; do not use existingCampaignId or existingAdSetId.

dailyBudget.description: Ad set daily budget in whole currency units; default for groups without a budget. A new campaign without an explicit campaign budget uses ABO. Ignored with a warning in an existing CBO campaign.

bidAmount.description: Group bid cap in whole account currency units; source bid strategy must support it.

dailyBudget.description: Group daily budget in whole account currency units. A new campaign without an explicit campaign budget uses ABO; every group needs a budget or adSet.dailyBudget default. For existing CBO campaigns, remove group budgets or create a new campaign.

lifetimeBudget.description: Group lifetime budget in whole account currency units. Requires schedule.endTime; exclusive with dailyBudget and explicit campaign budgets. A new campaign uses ABO; existing CBO campaigns reject group budgets.

media.description: Media references matched by upload ID, Meta ID/hash, exact filename, then variant base name. Ambiguity is an error. One media row may appear in several groups.

mediaIds.description: Upload IDs for this group, preferred over the corresponding names in media.

minimumRoas.description: Group minimum ROAS ratio, exclusive with bidAmount.

targeting.description: Custom-mode-only audience override for this ad set. Fields resolve after build-level targeting and before the source ad set; a matching adSet.targetingPerAdSet entry takes precedence.

id.description: ID of the existing destination ad set. Use adSet.id, not existingAdSetId.

lifetimeBudget.description: Ad set lifetime budget in whole account currency units. Requires schedule.endTime; mutually exclusive with dailyBudget and explicit campaign budgets. A new campaign uses ABO; existing CBO campaigns reject group budgets.

maxSpend.description: Maximum spend (cap) for this ad set under a CBO campaign, in whole currency units. Positive values require a campaign dailyBudget/lifetimeBudget in this request. Pass 0 to remove the cap the source ad set carries. Mutually exclusive with maxSpendPercentage.

maxSpendPercentage.description: Maximum spend for this ad set as a percentage of the CBO campaign budget (25 = 25%). Multiples of 5 only, matching Ads Manager. Also valid when the destination campaign is an existing CBO campaign. Meta only keeps percentage semantics when BOTH minSpendPercentage and maxSpendPercentage are set; a lone side is applied as its absolute equivalent. Mutually exclusive with maxSpend.

minSpend.description: Minimum spend for this ad set under a CBO campaign, in whole currency units. Positive values require a campaign dailyBudget/lifetimeBudget in this request. Pass 0 to remove the minimum the source ad set carries. Mutually exclusive with minSpendPercentage.

minSpendPercentage.description: Minimum spend for this ad set as a percentage of the CBO campaign budget (25 = 25%). Multiples of 5 only, matching Ads Manager. Also valid when the destination campaign is an existing CBO campaign. Meta only keeps percentage semantics when BOTH minSpendPercentage and maxSpendPercentage are set; a lone side is applied as its absolute equivalent. Mutually exclusive with minSpend.

minimumRoas.description: Minimum return-on-ad-spend goal as a ratio, e.g. 1.5 for 1.5x. Used by LOWEST_COST_WITH_MIN_ROAS and stored by Meta as bid_constraints.roas_average_floor.

name.description: Name for a new destination when id is omitted; it does not look up an existing destination by name.

names.description: Exact names for new ad sets, keyed by the JSON tuple [campaignKey, targetingKey, urlVariantKey or label]. Campaign keys use the campaign ID or campaign-index-N (1-based) for id-less multi-campaign entries; single-campaign plans use the name. Legacy name-based tuples still load. Applied after text resolution; texts.perAdset continues to use template names.

targetingPerAdSet.description: Per-ad-set audience overrides allowed in any ad-set mode. Keys are final planned ad-set names or IDs, or collision-safe campaign::name / campaign::ID keys for multi-campaign builds. Matching entries take precedence over adSet.groups[].targeting, then build-level targeting, then the source ad set.

campaign.description: Existing destination: set campaign.id. New destination: set campaign.name or a supported creation mode. Unsupported destination keys fail validation; do not use existingCampaignId or existingAdSetId.

campaigns.description: Campaign names may repeat. IDs are optional; supply unique IDs to address per-campaign profile overrides when names repeat.

dailyBudget.description: Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) daily budget in whole currency units, e.g. 100 for $100. Mutually exclusive with lifetimeBudget and with ad-set budgets. Omit to inherit the source campaign's budget, unless creating a new campaign with ad-set budgets (ABO).

id.description: ID of the existing destination campaign. Use campaign.id, not existingCampaignId.

lifetimeBudget.description: CBO lifetime budget in whole currency units. Mutually exclusive with dailyBudget and with ad-set budgets. Omit to inherit the source campaign's budget, unless creating a new campaign with ad-set budgets (ABO).

name.description: Name for a new destination when id is omitted; it does not look up an existing destination by name.

callToAction.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

cta.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.
Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

excludedFormats.description: Explicitly disable formats copied from the source ad. Each ID must be cloneable on the source and must not also appear in features or be enabled in the per-feature object. Unsupported for existing-post creatives. Omit to inherit both formats.

features.description: With useMetaDefaults: false, enables listed enhancements and disables other enhancements. Source carousel/collection formats are inherited even when omitted.

type.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

allowRepeatLaunch.description: Bypass both the 10-minute MCP body deduplication and 24-hour explicit-key deduplication. Set true only when the user explicitly wants the same ads created again. Unkeyed CLI and plain API requests already create new launches without this option.

endTime.description: Account-local time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm[:ss], or ISO 8601 with an offset or Z (converted to the account time zone). Any minute.

startTime.description: Account-local time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm[:ss], or ISO 8601 with an offset or Z (converted to the account time zone). Any minute.

_id.description: Stable captured media identity, retained when resuming a saved build.

customName.description: Exact ad name. Nonblank values preserve spaces and literal tokens with NFC normalization only; blank clears the panel rename.

partnershipAdEligibility.description: Meta ad-eligibility verdict for the partnership post, used for the licensed-music warning. Null or UNKNOWN means Meta did not say.

partnershipCreator.description: Optional expected creator identity, verified against Meta. It cannot replace the post owner or grant permission.

adCode.description: Sensitive Instagram ad code. Supply in the JSON body only; never in CLI arguments or URLs. Omitted from saved builds and output.

sourceFacebookPostId.description: Legacy empty web field only. Facebook headless imports are not supported.

adCode.description: Sensitive Instagram ad code. Supply in the JSON body only; never in CLI arguments or URLs. Omitted from saved builds and output.

callToAction.description: Meta CTA enum, for example SHOP_NOW, or empty string. Human labels such as Shop Now are not normalized on the partnership path. Nonempty CTA requires an http(s) link.

cta.description: Meta CTA enum, for example SHOP_NOW, or empty string. Human labels such as Shop Now are not normalized on the partnership path. Nonempty CTA requires an http(s) link.

multiAdvertiserAds.description: Whether to allow multi-advertiser ads; defaults to true when omitted and not inherited.

common.description: Shared imported-post text. Set shared sponsor fields in profile.partnership; put adCode in import or the active perAd/perAdset scope, never common.

sponsorInstagramId.description: Second Identity Instagram account ID. Omitted inherits; null removes this ID. Both sponsor IDs null means No Partner for uploaded media.

sponsorPageId.description: Second Identity Facebook Page ID. Omitted inherits. With sponsorInstagramId also null, removes the partner for this uploaded-media scope. Imported posts require an effective brand Page.

sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount.description: Uploaded media only: true uses the Instagram account as Second Identity without a Facebook Page. Requires an effective sponsorInstagramId.

useFacebookPage.description: Use the Facebook Page as the Instagram identity for Pages with no linked Instagram account. Cannot be combined with instagramId.

campaigns.description: Per-campaign Page, Instagram, and Threads overrides keyed by campaign ID or unambiguous campaign name from campaign.campaigns.

partnership.description: Partnerships using your own uploaded media on Facebook and Instagram, or existing Instagram posts. Choose the shared Second Identity and launch-wide header mode. Facebook post imports remain unsupported.

displayMode.description: Launch-wide header mode: both (ad_format 1), first (2, creator-only for imported posts, labelled Partner identity only), or dynamic (3). Defaults to both.

enabled.description: Set true for uploaded-media partnerships. Uploaded media uses ordinary assembly with the Second Identity. Imported posts always require partnership enabled.

pageUseInstagramAccount.description: Compatibility field; has no effect on the imported-post path. Creator identity is resolved from the post.

sourceFacebookPostId.description: Legacy field; a nonempty value is rejected for headless Facebook imports.

sourceInstagramMediaId.description: Legacy shared-source assertion. Prefer mediaItems[].sourceInstagramMediaId; if supplied here, it must match the single imported row.

sponsorInstagramId.description: Optional shared Second Identity Instagram account for uploaded media, or brand Instagram account for imported posts.

sponsorPageId.description: Shared Second Identity Facebook Page for uploaded media, or authorizing brand Page for imported Instagram posts. Per-campaign and active per-row values override this.

sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount.description: Uploaded media only: true uses an Instagram-only Second Identity, omitting its Facebook Page. Requires sponsorInstagramId. False or omitted for imported posts.

sponsorUseInstagramAccount.description: Legacy saved-build alias for sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount. Must be false or omitted for imported posts.

uploaderMode.description: True selects existing-post import and is rejected with uploaded media. Omit or set false for uploaded-media partnerships.

useFacebookPage.description: Use the Facebook Page as the Instagram identity for Pages with no linked Instagram account. Cannot be combined with instagramId.

adCode.description: Imported-post text only. Sensitive Instagram ad code. Supply in the JSON body only; never in CLI arguments or URLs. Omitted from saved builds and output.

bodies.description: Canonical array of bodies. Do not combine with an alias.

body.description: Alias for one value, converted to bodies: [body] on uploaded media. Do not combine with bodies or primaryText.

callToAction.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

cta.description: Standard website CTA type. Other Meta-valid values still pass through.

description.description: Alias for one value, converted to descriptions: [description] on uploaded media. Do not combine with descriptions.

descriptions.description: Canonical array of descriptions. Do not combine with an alias.

headline.description: A single headline string. For standard uploaded media this is an alias for headlines: [headline]; prefer headlines. If both are supplied, headlines must contain exactly this one string. Imported-post headline semantics are unchanged.

headlines.description: Canonical array of headlines. A matching singular headline is accepted only when this array contains exactly that one string; other aliases cannot be combined.

instagramId.description: Instagram account override for this ad or ad set. Null removes it; omit to inherit.

instagramPicture.description: Identity display metadata retained for uploaded-media overrides.

instagramUsername.description: Identity display metadata retained for uploaded-media overrides.

linkDescription.description: Accepted legacy alias for descriptions: a string becomes [value]; a string array is used as-is. Do not combine with descriptions or description.

pageId.description: Facebook Page override for this ad or ad set. Omit to inherit.

pageName.description: Identity display metadata retained for uploaded-media overrides.

pagePicture.description: Identity display metadata retained for uploaded-media overrides.

primaryText.description: Alias for one value, converted to bodies: [primaryText] on uploaded media. Do not combine with bodies or body.

profile.description: Nested row identity overrides used by the web text manager, including Page, Instagram, Threads and sponsor identity fields. Valid on filename and @profile:[...] row entries; missing fields inherit. Flat identity fields are also accepted on portable text blocks.

sponsorInstagramId.description: Second Identity Instagram account ID. Omitted inherits; null removes this ID. Both sponsor IDs null means No Partner for uploaded media.

sponsorInstagramPicture.description: Identity display metadata retained for uploaded-media overrides.

sponsorInstagramUsername.description: Identity display metadata retained for uploaded-media overrides.

sponsorPageId.description: Second Identity Facebook Page ID. Omitted inherits. With sponsorInstagramId also null, removes the partner for this uploaded-media scope. Imported posts require an effective brand Page.

sponsorPageName.description: Identity display metadata retained for uploaded-media overrides.

sponsorPagePicture.description: Identity display metadata retained for uploaded-media overrides.

sponsorPageUseInstagramAccount.description: Uploaded media only: true uses the Instagram account as Second Identity without a Facebook Page. Requires an effective sponsorInstagramId.

threadsId.description: Threads profile override for this ad or ad set. Null removes it; omit to inherit.

title.description: Accepted legacy alias for headlines: a string becomes [value]; a string array is used as-is. Do not combine with headlines, headline or titles.

titles.description: Accepted legacy alias for headlines: a string becomes [value]; a string array is used as-is. Do not combine with headlines, headline or title.

websiteUrl.description: Accepted legacy alias for link, kept as a plain string. Do not combine with link.

common.description: Shared copy and destination defaults in common, perAd and perAdset modes. Each row overrides only the fields it sets; ads without a row use these defaults.

partnership.description: Legacy uploader imported-post texts. Do not combine with canonical common/perAdset/perAd/mode.

perAd.description: Per-ad overrides keyed by file name or media:<uploadId>. A file name that two uploads share is refused (AMBIGUOUS_MEDIA): rename one, or key the text by media:<uploadId>. Upload IDs, Meta IDs/hashes and variant base names also resolve when they match exactly one upload. Imported posts allow one headline, optional text, and effective sponsor IDs; omitted fields inherit.

perAdSet.description: Compatibility alias for canonical texts.perAdset. Conflicting duplicate definitions are rejected.

perAdset.description: Per-ad-set text keyed by ad set name/ID or collision-safe campaign::key. Each key MUST exactly equal a FINAL planned ad-set name/ID — note ad-set names are often generated at create time (e.g. 'Ad Set 01') so a descriptive key that does not match the planned name will not resolve. For one-ad-per-ad-set builds prefer texts.perAd keyed by filename (robust shape); use perAdset only for ad sets that genuinely hold multiple ads.

adNames.description: Exact ad names keyed by mediaName. Overrides mediaItems[].customName and adNamePattern. Blank values clear an override; all other whitespace and tokens are literal.

adPresetId.description: Saved API preset settings and destination. Mutually exclusive with copyFromAd. Omitting a destination reuses the saved campaign/ad set and returns a PRESET_DESTINATION_USED warning. Override with campaign.name, named duplicate/split campaign.campaigns, or campaign.id / adSet.id.

buildId.description: Saved build ID. When provided, the build's portable spec is used as the create body.

carousel.description: Carousel creatives using media names from uploadId or captured mediaItems. Card text stays in the public AdSpec shape.

copyFromAd.description: Existing Meta ad ID to copy settings from.

flexible.description: Flexible-format creatives using media names from uploadId or captured mediaItems.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional launch key scoped to this user and account for 24 hours, for any client. Reuse it on retries to return the existing job. Without a key, only MCP requests deduplicate identical bodies, for 10 minutes from the original request; unkeyed CLI and plain API requests do not deduplicate.

launchBlockers.description: Saved-build metadata. Ignored when creating ads.

launchable.description: Saved-build metadata. Ignored when creating ads.

mediaItems.description: Portable saved-build media metadata. For videos, mediaItems[].mediaId MUST be the numeric Facebook video id from the upload response videoId, not its internal id. videoId is accepted as an alias. linkedAssets[] follow the same rule. Internal upload ids are resolved on save only for uploads owned by the authenticated user in the selected account; otherwise a video without a numeric id or batch link makes the build unlaunchable. When uploadId is unavailable or incomplete, images resolve by mediaHash and videos by mediaId. Standard, carousel, flexible, and placement videos also need thumbnailHash because the current creative pipeline requires it; Multi Media videos use their captured thumbnailUrl. Facebook identifiers are account-bound, so accountId must match the account captured with the media. Alternatively use Instagram existing-post partnership rows; posts and uploaded media cannot be mixed. Import by Instagram URL, shortcode, source ID, or ad code. Facebook post imports remain unsupported.

multimedia.description: Multi Media creatives with optional per-asset public text fields.

reason.description: Launch set to Approval only: one short note for the user explaining why (shown with the launch in their Agent Inbox). Ignored when Launch is Allowed.

resetAdNameIndexPerAdSet.description: Restart the {index} token for ad names in each ad set.

reviewId.description: Launch set to Approval only: put the held launch in this existing run from ads_edit_preview or ads_duplicate, so the user reviews the launch beside those changes (the changes and the launch run separately). Must be your user's run on this ad account. Ignored when Launch is Allowed.

runTitle.description: Launch set to Approval only: short name for this run. If the user names the run, use their exact words. Use the same runTitle (or reviewId) as your related ads_edit_preview or ads_duplicate calls so the launch and those changes are one Agent Inbox run, approved together. Ignored when Launch is Allowed.

targeting.description: AdSpec-shaped audience override for NEW ad sets: locations, optional age/gender, and one flat OR group of mixed detailed-targeting selections. Omitted fields inherit from the source ad set. Set detailedTargetingSelected=true with an empty detailedTargetingGroups array to clear inherited detailed targeting. Raw Meta flexible_spec is not accepted.

ageSelected.description: Whether the web UI age control was explicitly selected. Concrete age fields remain the payload authority.

countryCode.description: Display country code returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

key.description: Meta city key from geo search.

name.description: Display name returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

region.description: Display region returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

detailedTargetingGroups.description: Detailed-targeting groups in AdSpec form. Phase 1 supports one OR group. Each selection's type becomes its flexible_spec key; the outer array is reserved for future AND groups.

audienceSizeLower.description: Display-only lower audience-size estimate returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

audienceSizeUpper.description: Display-only upper audience-size estimate returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

path.description: Optional display-only category path; stripped before the Meta payload.

type.description: Meta detailed-targeting type, such as interests, work_employers, or an unknown future flexible_spec key.

value.description: Original primitive Meta value for detailed-targeting types that do not use id/name objects. Preserved exactly in flexible_spec.

detailedTargetingSelected.description: Whether detailed targeting is explicitly overridden. False or omitted inherits the source; true with an empty detailedTargetingGroups array clears inherited detailed targeting.

genderSelected.description: Whether the web UI gender control was explicitly selected. The genders field remains the payload authority.

interestGroups.description: Legacy version-3 interest-only groups. Accepted so saved builds written before mixed detailed targeting continue to launch.

path.description: Optional display-only category path; stripped before the Meta payload.

selectionVersion.description: Selection-metadata version. Version 4 is required for mixed detailed targeting; version 3 remains accepted for interest-only saved builds and version 2 for legacy age/gender builds. Does not reach Meta.

zips.description: Zip/postal codes to target, alongside or instead of cities. Find keys with targeting search type=zip.

countryCode.description: Display country code returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

key.description: Meta zip key from zip targeting search, e.g. "US:90210".

name.description: Display name returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

region.description: Display region returned by targeting search; stripped before the Meta payload.

textPresetId.description: Saved text preset ID. Mutually exclusive with texts.

uploadId.description: Upload batch ID returned by ads_upload or ads_get_upload.
